program:
alphabet a b c

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
is_c = symbol c
h1_1 = rightmost(is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_c@i, is_a@i & !is_c@i)
h1_2 = leftmost(is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_c@i & !is_b@j, is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_c@i)
h2_1 = rightmost(!h1_2@i & !is_b@j, !is_a@i & !h1_2@i & !is_a@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j)
accept = !is_bos & !is_a & !h1_1 & !h1_2 & h2_1

output accept
